# Install

The docs below are examples. The installer the agent runs is `scripts/setup.sh`.

```bash
sudo apt install trash-cli
```

```bash
sudo pacman -S trash-cli
```

```bash
sudo dnf install trash-cli
```

```bash
sudo mkdir --parent /.Trash
sudo chmod a+rw /.Trash
sudo chmod +t /.Trash
```
